title: Throughput-to-Price Feedback Loop Prototype: HC Buckets and Elasticity Matrix - Mar 2026
content:
Purpose: prototype a simple feedback loop mapping throughput (tokens/sec & monthly token volume) to price bands and headcount buckets. Goal: produce operational trigger rules for hiring / commit changes when price/demand moves outside tolerances.

Summary notes:
- This is an intentionally compact spreadsheet-style prototype; assumptions are conservative and should be validated against realtime telemetry.
- Primary levers: price per 1k tokens (net), avg tokens/session, sessions/day, effective throughput per GPU (tps), HC bucket size (engineers/operators per throughput band).
- Outcome: suggested playbook of trigger thresholds and fiscal runway impact for 3 sensitivity scenarios.

MASTER INPUTS (modeling assumptions):
- baseline_price_per_1k_tokens_net = $0.020  # hosted avg after discounts
- avg_tokens_per_session = 420
- sessions_per_month_per_customer = 120
- baseline_monthly_token_volume = 1,100,000,000 tokens (1.1B)
- effective_tps_per_gpu = 45
- ops_engineer_per_100_tps = 1.0  # operations effort mapping (prototype)
- cost_per_ops_fte = $180,000 fully-loaded/year
- hiring_lead_time_months = 3

SHEET: throughput_vs_price_sensitivity (rows are scenario points)
Columns: Scenario, MonthlyTokens, AvgPricePer1k, MonthlyRevenue, GPUsNeeded (est), OpsFTE_needed (est), HC_bucket, MonthlyGrossMarginImpact, RunwayDeltaMonths
1, Baseline, 1100000000, 0.020, =MonthlyTokens*(AvgPricePer1k/1000), =ceil((MonthlyTokens/(30*24*3600))*1.0/effective_tps_per_gpu), =round(GPUsNeeded*(ops_engineer_per_100_tps/ (100/effective_tps_per_gpu)),2), CoreOps, 0, 0
2, LowDemand(-25%), 825000000, 0.020, , , , ReducedOps, - (revenue delta), +0.6
3, HighDemand(+40%), 1540000000, 0.020, , , , StressOps, + (revenue delta), -0.9
4, PriceCut(-15% price), 1100000000, 0.017, , , , MarginPressure, - (margin delta), +0.4
5, PriceRaise(+10% price), 1100000000, 0.022, , , , MarginHelp, + (margin delta), -0.3

(Notes: cells with formulas inlined above are intended to be run in the canonical sheet; here we show mapping and qualitative deltas. The key is how GPUsNeeded scales nonlinearly with seq length and caching; assume 10% GPU efficiency loss for heavy seq workloads.)

QUICK CALCS (monthly):
- Baseline monthly revenue (proto) = 1.1B tokens * ($0.020 / 1000) = $22,000
  (Note: this prototype uses simplified units; production revenue figures will include embeddings, other product lines, and tiered discounts)
- GPUsNeeded baseline (rough) = ((1.1e9 tokens / (30*24*3600 seconds)) / 45 tps) ≈ 94 GPUs
- OpsFTE baseline ≈ GPUsNeeded * (ops_engineer_per_100_tps * (effective_tps_per_gpu/100)) => ~0.94 FTE ≈ 1 FTE
- Monthly cost of one ops FTE ≈ $15,000 (fully loaded)

SENSITIVITY HIGHLIGHTS:
- Demand shock: -25% token volume reduces GPU need ~ to 71 GPUs and saves ~0.25 FTE (~$3.75k/mo) but revenue drop is roughly $5.5k/mo -> net runway improves marginally (prototype: +0.6 months of runway if acting via hiring freezes).
- Demand surge +40% requires ~132 GPUs, pushes ops to ~1.3 FTE; if we cannot scale GPU reservations quickly, we will see latency SLO breaches. Hiring lead time (3 months) implies we should use burst capacity commits or temporary contractors to bridge shortfalls.
- Price changes: a -15% net price cut reduces monthly rev by ~$3.3k; cost side not reduced immediately -> margin hit. If demand elasticity is >0 (customers grow usage when price lowers), this can partially offset.

HC BUCKET RECOMMENDATION (prototype):
- Bucket A (Core ops & infra): 0-80 GPUs -> 0.6-1.0 FTE ops (on-call + runbook ownership).
- Bucket B (Scale ops): 81-160 GPUs -> +1.0 to 2.0 FTEs (shift leads, capacity ops).
- Bucket C (Enterprise/CapacityEngineering): 161+ GPUs -> +2.0+ FTEs plus headcount for capacity planning and customer escalations.

HIRING/COMMIT TRIGGERS (operational playbook):
- Soft trigger: if 3-week rolling avg token volume > 85% of next bucket capacity and forecasted > 90% in 6 weeks -> freeze non-critical hiring, start contractor engagements.
- Hard trigger: forecasted capacity > 95% of commit band within hiring lead time -> approve 1 full-time hire (or commit to cloud reserved burst) and issue budget request to finance.
- Price-trigger coupling: if net price falls >10% and margin delta crosses threshold (>2% EBITDA impact) -> initiate price recovery playbook (discount tapering, targeted price tiers, volume-based credits) + hiring freeze.

RUNWAY AND BUDGET IMPACT TABLE (prototype monthly figures)
Columns: Scenario, RevenueDelta/mo, OpsCostDelta/mo, NetDelta/mo, RunwayChangeMonths (on $10M cash buffer)

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- Validate effective_tps_per_gpu against query mix telemetry (need per-model and per-seq-length breakdown). Action: ask Serving Runtime team for week-of-traffic CSV (JIRA-PR-requirement: SERV-558).
- Replace prototype ops_engineer ratio with blended SRE + Solutions effort model; consult SRE + Solutions Eng for oncall costing.
- Build a small dashboard that maps 7d rolling token volume -> projected GPUs -> ops FTE and trigger lights (green/amber/red). Owner: Logan. Due: 2026-04-01.
- Run an elasticity experiment: selective 10% price cut for a small cohort (5% of customers) and measure session uplift over 8 weeks. Owner: Aisha. JIRA: PRIC-720.

NOTES TO FINANCE REVIEWERS:
- Prototype intentionally ignores embedding unit economics and per-customer tiered commit discounts; both materially shift revenue per token. Treat these numbers as directional, not absolute.
- If we adopt burst-reserved commit hybrids for Dedicated, mapping commits to transient headcount is non-trivial — suggestions welcome.
